lazy_loading.observed: Intermittent SIGABRT after inference and session destruction, at process exit. coredumpctl points to free/malloc_consolidate in libnvidia-gpucomp.so.595.71.05. Reproduced with cuDNN 9.27, 9.20, and 9.12; without profiling as well as with profiling. Algorithm fallback, CUDA_CACHE_DISABLE, and CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING alone did not resolve it.
lazy_loading.root_cause: Not established; this is an observed dependency/driver lifecycle failure.

qualified_configuration.evidence: 20 fresh processes, 10 with profiling; 1,000 inference calls each. All returned 0. The final eight benchmark processes also returned 0 and passed all reference cases.

excluded_evidence: Earlier exploratory CUDA timings are not included as qualified results. The benchmark driver rejects nonzero child exits even if a result was printed.
